title: A Bowl from the Clay Class
story: Kenji joined a Saturday clay class at the town museum. The teacher gave each student a lump of soft clay and a cloth. Kenji wanted to make a bowl for his mother's birthday. He pressed the centre with his thumbs and turned the clay in his hands. The walls became thin, and a crack appeared. The teacher showed him how to smooth the crack with a wet finger. Kenji tried again and shaped a simple wide bowl. He carved a small leaf on the side so it would be easy to recognise. The bowls dried on a shelf and were baked in a hot oven later. The next week he painted the leaf green. He wrapped it in paper and carried it home on the bus. His mother filled it with fruit and put it on the table. Kenji felt proud, because he had repaired the crack instead of starting again.
